1.zh: 太初有道，道与　神同在，道就是　神。
1.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

1.zh: 这道太初与　神同在。
1.en: The same was in the beginning with God.

1.zh: 万物是借着他造的；凡被造的，没有一样不是借着他造的。
1.en: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

1.zh: 生命在他里头，这生命就是人的光。
1.en: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

1.zh: 光照在黑暗里，黑暗却不接受光。
1.en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

1.zh: 有一个人，是从　神那里差来的，名叫约翰。
1.en: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

1.zh: 这人来，为要作见证，就是为光作见证，叫众人因他可以信。
1.en: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

1.zh: 他不是那光，乃是要为光作见证。
1.en: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

1.zh: 那光是真光，照亮一切生在世上的人。
1.en: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

1.zh: 他在世界，世界也是借着他造的，世界却不认识他。
1.en: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

1.zh: 他到自己的地方来，自己的人倒不接待他。
1.en: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

1.zh: 凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，他就赐他们权柄作　神的儿女。
1.en: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

1.zh: 这等人不是从血气生的，不是从情欲生的，也不是从人意生的，乃是从　神生的。
1.en: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

1.zh: 道成了肉身，住在我们中间，充充满满地有恩典有真理。我们也见过他的荣光，正是父独生子的荣光。
1.en: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

1.zh: 约翰为他作见证，喊着说：「这就是我曾说：『那在我以后来的，反成了在我以前的，因他本来在我以前。』」
1.en: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

1.zh: 从他丰满[的恩典]里，我们都领受了，而且恩上加恩。
1.en: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

1.zh: 律法本是借着摩西传的；恩典和真理都是由耶稣基督来的。
1.en: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 从来没有人看见　神，只有在父怀里的独生子将他表明出来。
1.en: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

1.zh: 约翰所作的见证记在下面：犹太人从耶路撒冷差祭司和利未人到约翰那里，问他说：「你是谁？」
1.en: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

1.zh: 他就明说，并不隐瞒，明说：「我不是基督。」
1.en: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

1.zh: 他们又问他说：「这样，你是谁呢？是以利亚吗？」他说：「我不是。」「是那先知吗？」他回答说：「不是。」
1.en: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

1.zh: 于是他们说：「你到底是谁，叫我们好回复差我们来的人。你自己说，你是谁？」
1.en: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

1.zh: 他说：「我就是那在旷野有人声喊着说：『修直主的道路』，正如先知以赛亚所说的。」
1.en: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

1.zh: 那些人是法利赛人差来的；
1.en: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

1.zh: 他们就问他说：「你既不是基督，不是以利亚，也不是那先知，为什么施洗呢？」
1.en: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

1.zh: 约翰回答说：「我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你们中间，是你们不认识的，
1.en: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

1.zh: 就是那在我以后来的，我给他解鞋带也不配。」
1.en: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

1.zh: 这是在约旦河外伯大尼，约翰施洗的地方作的见证。
1.en: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

1.zh: 次日，约翰看见耶稣来到他那里，就说：「看哪，　神的羔羊，除去世人罪孽的！
1.en: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

1.zh: 这就是我曾说：『有一位在我以后来、反成了在我以前的，因他本来在我以前。』
1.en: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

1.zh: 我先前不认识他，如今我来用水施洗，为要叫他显明给以色列人。」
1.en: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

1.zh: 约翰又作见证说：「我曾看见圣灵，仿佛鸽子从天降下，住在他的身上。
1.en: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

1.zh: 我先前不认识他，只是那差我来用水施洗的、对我说：『你看见圣灵降下来，住在谁的身上，谁就是用圣灵施洗的。』
1.en: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

1.zh: 我看见了，就证明这是　神的儿子。」
1.en: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

1.zh: 再次日，约翰同两个门徒站在那里。
1.en: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

1.zh: 他见耶稣行走，就说：「看哪，这是　神的羔羊！」
1.en: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

1.zh: 两个门徒听见他的话，就跟从了耶稣。
1.en: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

1.zh: 耶稣转过身来，看见他们跟着，就问他们说：「你们要什么？」他们说：「拉比，在哪里住？」（拉比翻出来就是夫子。）
1.en: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

1.zh: 耶稣说：「你们来看。」他们就去看他在哪里住，这一天便与他同住；那时约有申正了。
1.en: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

1.zh: 听见约翰的话跟从耶稣的那两个人，一个是西门·彼得的兄弟安得烈。
1.en: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

1.zh: 他先找着自己的哥哥西门，对他说：「我们遇见弥赛亚了。」（弥赛亚翻出来就是基督。）
1.en: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

1.zh: 于是领他去见耶稣。耶稣看着他，说：「你是约翰的儿子西门，你要称为矶法。」（矶法翻出来就是彼得。）
1.en: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

1.zh: 又次日，耶稣想要往加利利去，遇见腓力，就对他说：「来跟从我吧。」
1.en: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

1.zh: 这腓力是伯赛大人，和安得烈、彼得同城。
1.en: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

1.zh: 腓力找着拿但业，对他说：「摩西在律法上所写的和众先知所记的那一位，我们遇见了，就是约瑟的儿子拿撒勒人耶稣。」
1.en: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

1.zh: 拿但业对他说：「拿撒勒还能出什么好的吗？」腓力说：「你来看！」
1.en: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

1.zh: 耶稣看见拿但业来，就指着他说：「看哪，这是个真以色列人，他心里是没有诡诈的。」
1.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

1.zh: 拿但业对耶稣说：「你从哪里知道我呢？」耶稣回答说：「腓力还没有招呼你，你在无花果树底下，我就看见你了。」
1.en: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

1.zh: 拿但业说：「拉比，你是　神的儿子，你是以色列的王！」
1.en: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

1.zh: 耶稣对他说：「因为我说『在无花果树底下看见你』，你就信吗？你将要看见比这更大的事」；
1.en: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

1.zh: 又说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们将要看见天开了，　神的使者上去下来在人子身上。」
1.en: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

2.zh: 第三日，在加利利的迦拿有娶亲的筵席，耶稣的母亲在那里。
2.en: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

2.zh: 耶稣和他的门徒也被请去赴席。
2.en: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

2.zh: 酒用尽了，耶稣的母亲对他说：「他们没有酒了。」
2.en: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

2.zh: 耶稣说：「母亲，我与你有什么相干？我的时候还没有到。」
2.en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

2.zh: 他母亲对用人说：「他告诉你们什么，你们就做什么。」
2.en: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

2.zh: 照犹太人洁净的规矩，有六口石缸摆在那里，每口可以盛两三桶水。
2.en: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

2.zh: 耶稣对用人说：「把缸倒满了水。」他们就倒满了，直到缸口。
2.en: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

2.zh: 耶稣又说：「现在可以舀出来，送给管筵席的。」他们就送了去。
2.en: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

2.zh: 管筵席的尝了那水变的酒，并不知道是哪里来的，只有舀水的用人知道。管筵席的便叫新郎来，
2.en: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

2.zh: 对他说：「人都是先摆上好酒，等客喝足了，才摆上次的，你倒把好酒留到如今！」
2.en: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

2.zh: 这是耶稣所行的头一件神迹，是在加利利的迦拿行的，显出他的荣耀来；他的门徒就信他了。
2.en: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

2.zh: 这事以后，耶稣与他的母亲、弟兄，和门徒都下迦百农去，在那里住了不多几日。
2.en: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

2.zh: 犹太人的逾越节近了，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。
2.en: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

2.zh: 看见殿里有卖牛、羊、鸽子的，并有兑换银钱的人坐在那里，
2.en: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

2.zh: 耶稣就拿绳子做成鞭子，把牛羊都赶出殿去，倒出兑换银钱之人的银钱，推翻他们的桌子，
2.en: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

2.zh: 又对卖鸽子的说：「把这些东西拿去！不要将我父的殿当作买卖的地方。」
2.en: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

2.zh: 他的门徒就想起[经上]记着说：「我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧。」
2.en: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

2.zh: 因此犹太人问他说：「你既做这些事，还显什么神迹给我们看呢？」
2.en: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

2.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们拆毁这殿，我三日内要再建立起来。」
2.en: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

2.zh: 犹太人便说：「这殿是四十六年才造成的，你三日内就再建立起来吗？」
2.en: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

2.zh: 但耶稣这话是以他的身体为殿。
2.en: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

2.zh: 所以到他从死里复活以后，门徒就想起他说过这话，便信了圣经和耶稣所说的。
2.en: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

2.zh: 当耶稣在耶路撒冷过逾越节的时候，有许多人看见他所行的神迹，就信了他的名。
2.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

2.zh: 耶稣却不将自己交托他们；因为他知道万人，
2.en: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

2.zh: 也用不着谁见证人怎样，因他知道人心里所存的。
2.en: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

3.zh: 有一个法利赛人，名叫尼哥德慕，是犹太人的官。
3.en: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

3.zh: 这人夜里来见耶稣，说：「拉比，我们知道你是由　神那里来作师傅的；因为你所行的神迹，若没有　神同在，无人能行。」
3.en: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

3.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你，人若不重生，就不能见　神的国。」
3.en: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

3.zh: 尼哥德慕说：「人已经老了，如何能重生呢？岂能再进母腹生出来吗？」
3.en: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

3.zh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你，人若不是从水和[圣]灵生的，就不能进　神的国。
3.en: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

3.zh: 从肉身生的就是肉身；从灵生的就是灵。
3.en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

3.zh: 我说：『你们必须重生』，你不要以为希奇。
3.en: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

3.zh: 风随着意思吹，你听见风的响声，却不晓得从哪里来，往哪里去；凡从[圣]灵生的，也是如此。」
3.en: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

3.zh: 尼哥德慕问他说：「怎能有这事呢？」
3.en: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

3.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你是以色列人的先生，还不明白这事吗？
3.en: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

3.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你，我们所说的是我们知道的；我们所见证的是我们见过的；你们却不领受我们的见证。
3.en: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

3.zh: 我对你们说地上的事，你们尚且不信，若说天上的事，如何能信呢？
3.en: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

3.zh: 除了从天降下、仍旧在天的人子，没有人升过天。
3.en: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

3.zh: 摩西在旷野怎样举蛇，人子也必照样被举起来，
3.en: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

3.zh: 叫一切信他的都得永生。
3.en: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

3.zh: 「　神爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给[他们]，叫一切信他的，不致灭亡，反得永生。
3.en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

3.zh: 因为　神差他的儿子降世，不是要定世人的罪，乃是要叫世人因他得救。
3.en: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

3.zh: 信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，罪已经定了，因为他不信　神独生子的名。
3.en: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

3.zh: 光来到世间，世人因自己的行为是恶的，不爱光，倒爱黑暗，定他们的罪就是在此。
3.en: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

3.zh: 凡作恶的便恨光，并不来就光，恐怕他的行为受责备。
3.en: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

3.zh: 但行真理的必来就光，要显明他所行的是靠　神而行。」
3.en: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

3.zh: 这事以后，耶稣和门徒到了犹太地，在那里居住，施洗。
3.en: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

3.zh: 约翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗；因为那里水多，众人都去受洗。（
3.en: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

3.zh: 那时约翰还没有下在监里。）
3.en: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

3.zh: 约翰的门徒和一个犹太人辩论洁净的礼，
3.en: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

3.zh: 就来见约翰，说：「拉比，从前同你在约旦河外、你所见证的那位，现在施洗，众人都往他那里去了。」
3.en: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

3.zh: 约翰说：「若不是从天上赐的，人就不能得什么。
3.en: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

3.zh: 我曾说：『我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的』，你们自己可以给我作见证。
3.en: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

3.zh: 娶新妇的就是新郎；新郎的朋友站着，听见新郎的声音就甚喜乐。故此，我这喜乐满足了。
3.en: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

3.zh: 他必兴旺，我必衰微。」
3.en: He must increase, but I must decrease.

3.zh: 「从天上来的是在万有之上；从地上来的是属乎地，他所说的也是属乎地。从天上来的是在万有之上。
3.en: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

3.zh: 他将所见所闻的见证出来，只是没有人领受他的见证。
3.en: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

3.zh: 那领受他见证的，就印上印，证明　神是真的。
3.en: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

3.zh: 神所差来的就说　神的话，因为　神赐[圣]灵[给他]是没有限量的。
3.en: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

3.zh: 父爱子，已将万有交在他手里。
3.en: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

3.zh: 信子的人有永生；不信子的人得不着[永]生，　神的震怒常在他身上。」
3.en: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

4.zh: 主知道法利赛人听见他收门徒，施洗，比约翰还多，（
4.en: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

4.zh: 其实不是耶稣亲自施洗，乃是他的门徒施洗，）
4.en: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

4.zh: 他就离了犹太，又往加利利去。
4.en: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

4.zh: 必须经过撒马利亚，
4.en: He needed to pass through Samaria.

4.zh: 于是到了撒马利亚的一座城，名叫叙加，靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地。
4.en: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

4.zh: 在那里有雅各井；耶稣因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那时约有午正。
4.en: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

4.zh: 有一个撒马利亚的妇人来打水。耶稣对她说：「请你给我水喝。」（
4.en: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

4.zh: 那时门徒进城买食物去了。）
4.en: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

4.zh: 撒马利亚的妇人对他说：「你既是犹太人，怎么向我一个撒马利亚妇人要水喝呢？」原来犹太人和撒马利亚人没有来往。
4.en: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

4.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你若知道　神的恩赐，和对你说『给我水喝』的是谁，你必早求他，他也必早给了你活水。」
4.en: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

4.zh: 妇人说：「先生，没有打水的器具，井又深，你从哪里得活水呢？
4.en: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

4.zh: 我们的祖宗雅各将这井留给我们，他自己和儿子并牲畜也都喝这井里的水，难道你比他还大吗？」
4.en: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

4.zh: 耶稣回答说：「凡喝这水的还要再渴；
4.en: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

4.zh: 人若喝我所赐的水就永远不渴。我所赐的水要在他里头成为泉源，直涌到永生。」
4.en: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

4.zh: 妇人说：「先生，请把这水赐给我，叫我不渴，也不用来这么远打水。」
4.en: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

4.zh: 耶稣说：「你去叫你丈夫也到这里来。」
4.en: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

4.zh: 妇人说：「我没有丈夫。」耶稣说：「你说没有丈夫是不错的。
4.en: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

4.zh: 你已经有五个丈夫，你现在有的并不是你的丈夫。你这话是真的。」
4.en: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

4.zh: 妇人说：「先生，我看出你是先知。
4.en: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

4.zh: 我们的祖宗在这山上礼拜，你们倒说，应当礼拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」
4.en: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

4.zh: 耶稣说：「妇人，你当信我。时候将到，你们拜父，也不在这山上，也不在耶路撒冷。
4.en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

4.zh: 你们所拜的，你们不知道；我们所拜的，我们知道，因为救恩是从犹太人出来的。
4.en: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

4.zh: 时候将到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心灵和诚实拜他，因为父要这样的人拜他。」
4.en: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

4.zh: 神是个灵，所以拜他的必须用心灵和诚实拜他。
4.en: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

4.zh: 妇人说：「我知道弥赛亚（就是那称为基督的）要来；他来了，必将一切的事都告诉我们。」
4.en: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

4.zh: 耶稣说：「这和你说话的就是他！」
4.en: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

4.zh: 当下门徒回来，就希奇耶稣和一个妇人说话；只是没有人说：「你是要什么？」或说：「你为什么和她说话？」
4.en: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

4.zh: 那妇人就留下水罐子，往城里去，对众人说：
4.en: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

4.zh: 「你们来看！有一个人将我素来所行的一切事都给我说出来了，莫非这就是基督吗？」
4.en: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

4.zh: 众人就出城，往耶稣那里去。
4.en: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

4.zh: 这其间，门徒对耶稣说：「拉比，请吃。」
4.en: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

4.zh: 耶稣说：「我有食物吃，是你们不知道的。」
4.en: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

4.zh: 门徒就彼此对问说：「莫非有人拿什么给他吃吗？」
4.en: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

4.zh: 耶稣说：「我的食物就是遵行差我来者的旨意，做成他的工。
4.en: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

4.zh: 你们岂不说『到收割的时候还有四个月』吗？我告诉你们，举目向田观看，庄稼已经熟了，可以收割了。
4.en: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

4.zh: 收割的人得工价，积蓄五谷到永生，叫撒种的和收割的一同快乐。
4.en: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

4.zh: 俗语说：『那人撒种，这人收割』，这话可见是真的。
4.en: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

4.zh: 我差你们去收你们所没有劳苦的；别人劳苦，你们享受他们所劳苦的。」
4.en: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

4.zh: 那城里有好些撒马利亚人信了耶稣，因为那妇人作见证说：「他将我素来所行的一切事都给我说出来了。」
4.en: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

4.zh: 于是撒马利亚人来见耶稣，求他在他们那里住下，他便在那里住了两天。
4.en: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

4.zh: 因耶稣的话，信的人就更多了，
4.en: Many more believed because of his word.

4.zh: 便对妇人说：「现在我们信，不是因为你的话，是我们亲自听见了，知道这真是救世主。」
4.en: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

4.zh: 过了那两天，耶稣离了那地方，往加利利去。
4.en: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

4.zh: 因为耶稣自己作过见证说：「先知在本地是没有人尊敬的。」
4.en: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

4.zh: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看见他在耶路撒冷过节所行的一切事，就接待他，因为他们也是上去过节。
4.en: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

4.zh: 耶稣又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他从前变水为酒的地方。有一个大臣，他的儿子在迦百农患病。
4.en: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

4.zh: 他听见耶稣从犹太到了加利利，就来见他，求他下去医治他的儿子，因为他儿子快要死了。
4.en: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

4.zh: 耶稣就对他说：「若不看见神迹奇事，你们总是不信。」
4.en: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

4.zh: 那大臣说：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子还没有死就下去。」
4.en: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

4.zh: 耶稣对他说：「回去吧，你的儿子活了！」那人信耶稣所说的话就回去了。
4.en: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

4.zh: 正下去的时候，他的仆人迎见他，说他的儿子活了。
4.en: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

4.zh: 他就问什么时候见好的。他们说：「昨日未时热就退了。」
4.en: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

4.zh: 他便知道这正是耶稣对他说「你儿子活了」的时候；他自己和全家就都信了。
4.en: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

4.zh: 这是耶稣在加利利行的第二件神迹，是他从犹太回去以后行的。
4.en: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

5.zh: 这事以后，到了犹太人的一个节期，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。
5.en: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

5.zh: 在耶路撒冷，靠近羊[门]有一个池子，希伯来话叫作毕士大，[旁边]有五个廊子；
5.en: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

5.zh: 里面躺着瞎眼的、瘸腿的、血气枯干的许多病人。
5.en: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

5.zh: 在那里有一个人，病了三十八年。
5.en: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

5.zh: 耶稣看见他躺着，知道他病了许久，就问他说：「你要痊愈吗？」
5.en: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

5.zh: 病人回答说：「先生，水动的时候，没有人把我放在池子里；我正去的时候，就有别人比我先下去。」
5.en: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

5.zh: 耶稣对他说：「起来，拿你的褥子走吧！」
5.en: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

5.zh: 那人立刻痊愈，就拿起褥子来走了。
5.en: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

5.zh: 那天是安息日，所以犹太人对那医好的人说：「今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。」
5.en: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

5.zh: 他却回答说：「那使我痊愈的，对我说：『拿你的褥子走吧。』」
5.en: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

5.zh: 他们问他说：「对你说『拿褥子走』的是什么人？」
5.en: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

5.zh: 那医好的人不知道是谁；因为那里的人多，耶稣已经躲开了。
5.en: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

5.zh: 后来耶稣在殿里遇见他，对他说：「你已经痊愈了，不要再犯罪，恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。」
5.en: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

5.zh: 那人就去告诉犹太人，使他痊愈的是耶稣。
5.en: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

5.zh: 所以犹太人逼迫耶稣，因为他在安息日做了这事。
5.en: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

5.zh: 耶稣就对他们说：「我父做事直到如今，我也做事。」
5.en: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

5.zh: 所以犹太人越发想要杀他；因他不但犯了安息日，并且称　神为他的父，将自己和　神当作平等。
5.en: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

5.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，子凭着自己不能做什么，惟有看见父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照样做。
5.en: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

5.zh: 父爱子，将自己所做的一切事指给他看，还要将比这更大的事指给他看，叫你们希奇。
5.en: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

5.zh: 父怎样叫死人起来，使他们活着，子也照样随自己的意思使人活着。
5.en: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

5.zh: 父不审判什么人，乃将审判的事全交与子，
5.en: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

5.zh: 叫人都尊敬子如同尊敬父一样。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子来的父。
5.en: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

5.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，那听我话、又信差我来者的，就有永生；不至于定罪，是已经出死入生了。
5.en: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

5.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，时候将到，现在就是了，死人要听见　神儿子的声音，听见的人就要活了。
5.en: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

5.zh: 因为父怎样在自己有生命，就赐给他儿子也照样在自己有生命，
5.en: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

5.zh: 并且因为他是人子，就赐给他行审判的权柄。
5.en: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

5.zh: 你们不要把这事看作希奇。时候要到，凡在坟墓里的，都要听见他的声音，就出来：
5.en: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

5.zh: 行善的，复活得生；作恶的，复活定罪。
5.en: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

5.zh: 「我凭着自己不能做什么，我怎么听见就怎么审判。我的审判也是公平的；因为我不求自己的意思，只求那差我来者的意思。」
5.en: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

5.zh: 「我若为自己作见证，我的见证就不真。
5.en: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

5.zh: 另有一位给我作见证，我也知道他给我作的见证是真的。
5.en: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

5.zh: 你们曾差人到约翰那里，他为真理作过见证。
5.en: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

5.zh: 其实，我所受的见证不是从人来的；然而，我说这些话，为要叫你们得救。
5.en: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

5.zh: 约翰是点着的明灯，你们情愿暂时喜欢他的光。
5.en: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

5.zh: 但我有比约翰更大的见证；因为父交给我要我成就的事，就是我所做的事，这便见证我是父所差来的。
5.en: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

5.zh: 差我来的父也为我作过见证。你们从来没有听见他的声音，也没有看见他的形象。
5.en: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

5.zh: 你们并没有他的道存在心里；因为他所差来的，你们不信。
5.en: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

5.zh: 你们查考圣经，因你们以为内中有永生；给我作见证的就是这经。
5.en: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

5.zh: 然而，你们不肯到我这里来得生命。
5.en: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

5.zh: 「我不受从人来的荣耀。
5.en: I don’t receive glory from men.

5.zh: 但我知道，你们心里没有　神的爱。
5.en: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

5.zh: 我奉我父的名来，你们并不接待我；若有别人奉自己的名来，你们倒要接待他。
5.en: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

5.zh: 你们互相受荣耀，却不求从独一之　神来的荣耀，怎能信[我]呢？
5.en: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

5.zh: 不要想我在父面前要告你们；有一位告你们的，就是你们所仰赖的摩西。
5.en: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

5.zh: 你们如果信摩西，也必信我，因为他[书上]有指着我写的话。
5.en: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

5.zh: 你们若不信他的书，怎能信我的话呢？」
5.en: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

6.zh: 这事以后，耶稣渡过加利利海，就是提比哩亚海。
6.en: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

6.zh: 有许多人因为看见他在病人身上所行的神迹，就跟随他。
6.en: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

6.zh: 耶稣上了山，和门徒一同坐在那里。
6.en: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

6.zh: 那时犹太人的逾越节近了。
6.en: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

6.zh: 耶稣举目看见许多人来，就对腓力说：「我们从哪里买饼叫这些人吃呢？」（
6.en: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

6.zh: 他说这话是要试验腓力；他自己原知道要怎样行。）
6.en: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

6.zh: 腓力回答说：「就是二十两银子的饼，叫他们各人吃一点也是不够的。」
6.en: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

6.zh: 有一个门徒，就是西门·彼得的兄弟安得烈，对耶稣说：
6.en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

6.zh: 「在这里有一个孩童，带着五个大麦饼、两条鱼，只是分给这许多人还算什么呢？」
6.en: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

6.zh: 耶稣说：「你们叫众人坐下。」原来那地方的草多，众人就坐下，数目约有五千。
6.en: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

6.zh: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就分给那坐着的人；分鱼也是这样，都随着他们所要的。
6.en: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

6.zh: 他们吃饱了，耶稣对门徒说：「把剩下的零碎收拾起来，免得有糟蹋的。」
6.en: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

6.zh: 他们便将那五个大麦饼的零碎，就是众人吃了剩下的，收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
6.en: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

6.zh: 众人看见耶稣所行的神迹，就说：「这真是那要到世间来的先知！」
6.en: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

6.zh: 耶稣既知道众人要来强逼他作王，就独自又退到山上去了。
6.en: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

6.zh: 到了晚上，他的门徒下海边去，
6.en: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

6.zh: 上了船，要过海往迦百农去。天已经黑了，耶稣还没有来到他们那里。
6.en: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

6.zh: 忽然狂风大作，海就翻腾起来。
6.en: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

6.zh: 门徒摇橹，约行了十里多路，看见耶稣在海面上走，渐渐近了船，他们就害怕。
6.en: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

6.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「是我，不要怕！」
6.en: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

6.zh: 门徒就喜欢接他上船，船立时到了他们所要去的地方。
6.en: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

6.zh: 第二日，站在海那边的众人知道那里没有别的船，只有一只小船，又知道耶稣没有同他的门徒上船，乃是门徒自己去的。
6.en: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

6.zh: 然而，有几只小船从提比哩亚来，靠近主祝谢后[分饼给人]吃的地方。
6.en: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

6.zh: 众人见耶稣和门徒都不在那里，就上了船，往迦百农去找耶稣。
6.en: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

6.zh: 既在海那边找着了，就对他说：「拉比，是几时到这里来的？」
6.en: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

6.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们找我，并不是因见了神迹，乃是因吃饼得饱。
6.en: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

6.zh: 不要为那必坏的食物劳力，要为那存到永生的食物劳力，就是人子要赐给你们的，因为人子是父　神所印证的。」
6.en: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

6.zh: 众人问他说：「我们当行什么才算做　神的工呢？」
6.en: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

6.zh: 耶稣回答说：「信　神所差来的，这就是做　神的工。」
6.en: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

6.zh: 他们又说：「你行什么神迹，叫我们看见就信你；你到底做什么事呢？
6.en: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

6.zh: 我们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，如[经上]写着说：『他从天上赐下粮来给他们吃。』」
6.en: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

6.zh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，那从天上来的粮不是摩西赐给你们的，乃是我父将天上来的真粮赐给你们。
6.en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

6.zh: 因为　神的粮就是那从天上降下来、赐生命给世界的。」
6.en: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

6.zh: 他们说：「主啊，常将这粮赐给我们！」
6.en: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

6.zh: 耶稣说：「我就是生命的粮。到我这里来的，必定不饿；信我的，永远不渴。
6.en: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

6.zh: 只是我对你们说过，你们已经看见我，还是不信。
6.en: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

6.zh: 凡父所赐给我的人必到我这里来；到我这里来的，我总不丢弃他。
6.en: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

6.zh: 因为我从天上降下来，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我来者的意思行。
6.en: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

6.zh: 差我来者的意思就是：他所赐给我的，叫我一个也不失落，在末日却叫他复活。
6.en: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

6.zh: 因为我父的意思是叫一切见子而信的人得永生，并且在末日我要叫他复活。」
6.en: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

6.zh: 犹太人因为耶稣说「我是从天上降下来的粮」，就私下议论他，
6.en: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

6.zh: 说：「这不是约瑟的儿子耶稣吗？他的父母我们岂不认得吗？他如今怎么说『我是从天上降下来的』呢？」
6.en: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

6.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们不要大家议论。
6.en: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

6.zh: 若不是差我来的父吸引人，就没有能到我这里来的；[到我这里来的]，在末日我要叫他复活。
6.en: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

6.zh: 在先知书上写着说：『他们都要蒙　神的教训。』凡听见父[之教训]又学习的，就到我这里来。
6.en: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

6.zh: 这不是说有人看见过父，惟独从　神来的，他看见过父。
6.en: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

6.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，信的人有永生。
6.en: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

6.zh: 我就是生命的粮。
6.en: I am the bread of life.

6.zh: 你们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，还是死了。
6.en: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

6.zh: 这是从天上降下来的粮，叫人吃了就不死。
6.en: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

6.zh: 我是从天上降下来生命的粮；人若吃这粮，就必永远活着。我所要赐的粮就是我的肉，为世人之生命所赐的。」
6.en: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

6.zh: 因此，犹太人彼此争论说：「这个人怎能把他的肉给我们吃呢？」
6.en: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

6.zh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就没有生命在你们里面。
6.en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

6.zh: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他复活。
6.en: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

6.zh: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。
6.en: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

6.zh: 吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我里面，我也常在他里面。
6.en: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

6.zh: 永活的父怎样差我来，我又因父活着；照样，吃我[肉]的人也要因我活着。
6.en: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

6.zh: 这就是从天上降下来的粮。吃这粮的人就永远活着，不像[你们的]祖宗吃过[吗哪]还是死了。」
6.en: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

6.zh: 这些话是耶稣在迦百农会堂里教训人说的。
6.en: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

6.zh: 他的门徒中有好些人听见了，就说：「这话甚难，谁能听呢？」
6.en: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

6.zh: 耶稣心里知道门徒为这话议论，就对他们说：「这话是叫你们厌弃吗？
6.en: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

6.zh: 倘或你们看见人子升到他原来所在之处，怎么样呢？
6.en: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

6.zh: 叫人活着的乃是灵，肉体是无益的。我对你们所说的话就是灵，就是生命。
6.en: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

6.zh: 只是你们中间有不信的人。」耶稣从起头就知道谁不信他，谁要卖他。
6.en: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

6.zh: 耶稣又说：「所以我对你们说过，若不是蒙我父的恩赐，没有人能到我这里来。」
6.en: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

6.zh: 从此，他门徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。
6.en: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

6.zh: 耶稣就对那十二个门徒说：「你们也要去吗？」
6.en: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

6.zh: 西门·彼得回答说：「主啊，你有永生之道，我们还归从谁呢？
6.en: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

6.zh: 我们已经信了，又知道你是　神的圣者。」
6.en: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

6.zh: 耶稣说：「我不是拣选了你们十二个门徒吗？但你们中间有一个是魔鬼。」
6.en: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

6.zh: 耶稣这话是指着加略人西门的儿子犹大说的；他本是十二个门徒里的一个，后来要卖耶稣的。
6.en: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

7.zh: 这事以后，耶稣在加利利游行，不愿在犹太游行，因为犹太人想要杀他。
7.en: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

7.zh: 当时犹太人的住棚节近了。
7.en: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

7.zh: 耶稣的弟兄就对他说：「你离开这里上犹太去吧，叫你的门徒也看见你所行的事。
7.en: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

7.zh: 人要显扬名声，没有在暗处行事的；你如果行这些事，就当将自己显明给世人看。」
7.en: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

7.zh: 因为连他的弟兄[说这话]，是因为不信他。
7.en: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

7.zh: 耶稣就对他们说：「我的时候还没有到；你们的时候常是方便的。
7.en: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

7.zh: 世人不能恨你们，却是恨我，因为我指证他们所做的事是恶的。
7.en: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

7.zh: 你们上去过节吧，我现在不上去过这节，因为我的时候还没有满。」
7.en: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

7.zh: 耶稣说了这话，仍旧住在加利利。
7.en: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

7.zh: 但他弟兄上去以后，他也上去过节，不是明去，似乎是暗去的。
7.en: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

7.zh: 正在节期，犹太人寻找耶稣，说：「他在哪里？」
7.en: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

7.zh: 众人为他纷纷议论，有的说：「他是好人。」有的说：「不然，他是迷惑众人的。」
7.en: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

7.zh: 只是没有人明明地讲论他，因为怕犹太人。
7.en: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

7.zh: 到了节期，耶稣上殿里去教训人。
7.en: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

7.zh: 犹太人就希奇，说：「这个人没有学过，怎么明白书呢？」
7.en: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

7.zh: 耶稣说：「我的教训不是我自己的，乃是那差我来者的。
7.en: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

7.zh: 人若立志遵着他的旨意行，就必晓得这教训或是出于　神，或是我凭着自己说的。
7.en: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

7.zh: 人凭着自己说，是求自己的荣耀；惟有求那差他来者的荣耀，这人是真的，在他心里没有不义。
7.en: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

7.zh: 摩西岂不是传律法给你们吗？你们却没有一个人守律法。为什么想要杀我呢？」
7.en: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

7.zh: 众人回答说：「你是被鬼附着了！谁想要杀你？」
7.en: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

7.zh: 耶稣说：「我做了一件事，你们都以为希奇。
7.en: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

7.zh: 摩西传割礼给你们（其实不是从摩西起的，乃是从祖先起的），因此你们也在安息日给人行割礼。
7.en: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

7.zh: 人若在安息日受割礼，免得违背摩西的律法，我在安息日叫一个人全然好了，你们就向我生气吗？
7.en: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

7.zh: 不可按外貌断定是非，总要按公平断定是非。」
7.en: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

7.zh: 耶路撒冷人中有的说：「这不是他们想要杀的人吗？
7.en: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

7.zh: 你看他还明明地讲道，他们也不向他说什么，难道官长真知道这是基督吗？
7.en: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

7.zh: 然而，我们知道这个人从哪里来；只是基督来的时候，没有人知道他从哪里来。」
7.en: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

7.zh: 那时，耶稣在殿里教训人，大声说：「你们也知道我，也知道我从哪里来；我来并不是由于自己。但那差我来的是真的。你们不认识他，
7.en: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

7.zh: 我却认识他；因为我是从他来的，他也是差了我来。」
7.en: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

7.zh: 他们就想要捉拿耶稣；只是没有人下手，因为他的时候还没有到。
7.en: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

7.zh: 但众人中间有好些信他的，说：「基督来的时候，他所行的神迹岂能比这人所行的更多吗？」
7.en: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

7.zh: 法利赛人听见众人为耶稣这样纷纷议论，祭司长和法利赛人就打发差役去捉拿他。
7.en: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

7.zh: 于是耶稣说：「我还有不多的时候和你们同在，以后就回到差我来的那里去。
7.en: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

7.zh: 你们要找我，却找不着；我所在的地方你们不能到。」
7.en: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

7.zh: 犹太人就彼此对问说：「这人要往哪里去，叫我们找不着呢？难道他要往散住希腊中的犹太人那里去教训希腊人吗？
7.en: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

7.zh: 他说：『你们要找我，却找不着；我所在的地方，你们不能到』，这话是什么意思呢？」
7.en: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

7.zh: 节期的末日，就是最大之日，耶稣站着高声说：「人若渴了，可以到我这里来喝。
7.en: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

7.zh: 信我的人就如经上所说：『从他腹中要流出活水的江河来。』」
7.en: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

7.zh: 耶稣这话是指着信他之人要受[圣]灵说的。那时还没有[赐下圣]灵[来]，因为耶稣尚未得着荣耀。
7.en: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

7.zh: 众人听见这话，有的说：「这真是那先知。」
7.en: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

7.zh: 有的说：「这是基督。」但也有的说：「基督岂是从加利利出来的吗？
7.en: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

7.zh: 经上岂不是说『基督是大卫的后裔，从大卫本乡伯利恒出来的』吗？」
7.en: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

7.zh: 于是众人因着耶稣起了纷争。
7.en: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

7.zh: 其中有人要捉拿他，只是无人下手。
7.en: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

7.zh: 差役回到祭司长和法利赛人那里。他们对差役说：「你们为什么没有带他来呢？」
7.en: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

7.zh: 差役回答说：「从来没有像他这样说话的！」
7.en: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

7.zh: 法利赛人说：「你们也受了迷惑吗？
7.en: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

7.zh: 官长或是法利赛人岂有信他的呢？
7.en: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

7.zh: 但这些不明白律法的百姓是被咒诅的！」
7.en: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

7.zh: 内中有尼哥德慕，就是从前去见耶稣的，对他们说：
7.en: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

7.zh: 「不先听本人的口供，不知道他所做的事，难道我们的律法还定他的罪吗？」
7.en: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

7.zh: 他们回答说：「你也是出于加利利吗？你且去查考，就可知道加利利没有出过先知。」
7.en: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
Everyone went to his own house,

8.zh: 于是各人都回家去了；耶稣却往橄榄山去，
8.en: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

8.zh: 清早又回到殿里。众百姓都到他那里去，他就坐下，教训他们。
8.en: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

8.zh: 文士和法利赛人带着一个行淫时被拿的妇人来，叫她站在当中，
8.en: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

8.zh: 就对耶稣说：「夫子，这妇人是正行淫之时被拿的。
8.en: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

8.zh: 摩西在律法上吩咐我们把这样的妇人用石头打死。你说该把她怎么样呢？」
8.en: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

8.zh: 他们说这话，乃试探耶稣，要得着告他的把柄。耶稣却弯着腰，用指头在地上画字。
8.en: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

8.zh: 他们还是不住地问他，耶稣就直起腰来，对他们说：「你们中间谁是没有罪的，谁就可以先拿石头打她。」
8.en: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

8.zh: 于是又弯着腰，用指头在地上画字。
8.en: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

8.zh: 他们听见这话，就从老到少，一个一个地都出去了，只剩下耶稣一人，还有那妇人仍然站在当中。
8.en: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

8.zh: 耶稣就直起腰来，对她说：「妇人，那些人在哪里呢？没有人定你的罪吗？」
8.en: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

8.zh: 她说：「主啊，没有。」耶稣说：「我也不定你的罪。去吧，从此不要再犯罪了！」
8.en: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

8.zh: 耶稣又对众人说：「我是世界的光。跟从我的，就不在黑暗里走，必要得着生命的光。」
8.en: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

8.zh: 法利赛人对他说：「你是为自己作见证，你的见证不真。」
8.en: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「我虽然为自己作见证，我的见证还是真的；因我知道我从哪里来，往哪里去；你们却不知道我从哪里来，往哪里去。
8.en: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

8.zh: 你们是以外貌判断人，我却不判断人。
8.en: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

8.zh: 就是判断人，我的判断也是真的；因为不是我独自在这里，还有差我来的父与我同在。
8.en: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

8.zh: 你们的律法上也记着说：『两个人的见证是真的。』
8.en: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

8.zh: 我是为自己作见证，还有差我来的父也是为我作见证。」
8.en: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

8.zh: 他们就问他说：「你的父在哪里？」耶稣回答说：「你们不认识我，也不认识我的父；若是认识我，也就认识我的父。」
8.en: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

8.zh: 这些话是耶稣在殿里的库房、教训人时所说的，也没有人拿他，因为他的时候还没有到。
8.en: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

8.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「我要去了，你们要找我，并且你们要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你们不能到。」
8.en: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

8.zh: 犹太人说：「他说『我所去的地方，你们不能到』，难道他要自尽吗？」
8.en: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

8.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们是从下头来的，我是从上头来的；你们是属这世界的，我不是属这世界的。
8.en: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

8.zh: 所以我对你们说，你们要死在罪中。你们若不信我是[基督]，必要死在罪中。」
8.en: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

8.zh: 他们就问他说：「你是谁？」耶稣对他们说：「就是我从起初所告诉你们的。
8.en: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

8.zh: 我有许多事讲论你们，判断你们；但那差我来的是真的，我在他那里所听见的，我就传给世人。」
8.en: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

8.zh: 他们不明白耶稣是指着父说的。
8.en: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

8.zh: 所以耶稣说：「你们举起人子以后，必知道我是[基督]，并且知道我没有一件事是凭着自己做的。我说这些话乃是照着父所教训我的。
8.en: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

8.zh: 那差我来的是与我同在；他没有撇下我独自在这里，因为我常做他所喜悦的事。」
8.en: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

8.zh: 耶稣说这话的时候，就有许多人信他。
8.en: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

8.zh: 耶稣对信他的犹太人说：「你们若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的门徒；
8.en: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

8.zh: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。」
8.en: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

8.zh: 他们回答说：「我们是亚伯拉罕的后裔，从来没有作过谁的奴仆。你怎么说『你们必得以自由』呢？」
8.en: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

8.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴仆。
8.en: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

8.zh: 奴仆不能永远住在家里；儿子是永远住在家里。
8.en: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

8.zh: 所以[天父的]儿子若叫你们自由，你们就真自由了。
8.en: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

8.zh: 我知道你们是亚伯拉罕的子孙，你们却想要杀我，因为你们心里容不下我的道。
8.en: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

8.zh: 我所说的是在我父那里看见的；你们所行的是在你们的父那里听见的。」
8.en: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

8.zh: 他们说：「我们的父就是亚伯拉罕。」耶稣说：「你们若是亚伯拉罕的儿子，就必行亚伯拉罕所行的事。
8.en: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

8.zh: 我将在　神那里所听见的真理告诉了你们，现在你们却想要杀我，这不是亚伯拉罕所行的事。
8.en: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

8.zh: 你们是行你们父所行的事。」他们说：「我们不是从淫乱生的；我们只有一位父，就是　神。」
8.en: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「倘若　神是你们的父，你们就必爱我；因为我本是出于　神，也是从　神而来，并不是由着自己来，乃是他差我来。
8.en: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

8.zh: 你们为什么不明白我的话呢？无非是因你们不能听我的道。
8.en: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

8.zh: 你们是出于你们的父魔鬼，你们父的私欲你们偏要行。他从起初是杀人的，不守真理，因他心里没有真理。他说谎是出于自己；因他本来是说谎的，也是说谎之人的父。
8.en: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

8.zh: 我将真理告诉你们，你们就因此不信我。
8.en: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

8.zh: 你们中间谁能指证我有罪呢？我既然将真理告诉你们，为什么不信我呢？
8.en: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

8.zh: 出于　神的，必听　神的话；你们不听，因为你们不是出于　神。」
8.en: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

8.zh: 犹太人回答说：「我们说你是撒马利亚人，并且是鬼附着的，这话岂不正对吗？」
8.en: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「我不是鬼附着的；我尊敬我的父，你们倒轻慢我。
8.en: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

8.zh: 我不求自己的荣耀，有一位[为我]求[荣耀]、定是非的。
8.en: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

8.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，人若遵守我的道，就永远不见死。」
8.en: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

8.zh: 犹太人对他说：「现在我们知道你是鬼附着的。亚伯拉罕死了，众先知也死了，你还说：『人若遵守我的道，就永远不尝死味。』
8.en: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

8.zh: 难道你比我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕还大吗？他死了，众先知也死了，你将自己当作什么人呢？」
8.en: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

8.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我若荣耀自己，我的荣耀就算不得什么；荣耀我的乃是我的父，就是你们所说是你们的　神。
8.en: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

8.zh: 你们未曾认识他；我却认识他。我若说不认识他，我就是说谎的，像你们一样；但我认识他，也遵守他的道。
8.en: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

8.zh: 你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕欢欢喜喜地仰望我的日子，既看见了就快乐。」
8.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

8.zh: 犹太人说：「你还没有五十岁，岂见过亚伯拉罕呢？」
8.en: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，还没有亚伯拉罕就有了我。」
8.en: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

8.zh: 于是他们拿石头要打他；耶稣却躲藏，从殿里出去了。
8.en: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

9.zh: 耶稣过去的时候，看见一个人生来是瞎眼的。
9.en: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

9.zh: 门徒问耶稣说：「拉比，这人生来是瞎眼的，是谁犯了罪？是这人呢？是他父母呢？」
9.en: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

9.zh: 耶稣回答说：「也不是这人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上显出　神的作为来。
9.en: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

9.zh: 趁着白日，我们必须做那差我来者的工；黑夜将到，就没有人能做工了。
9.en: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

9.zh: 我在世上的时候，是世上的光。」
9.en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

9.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
9.en: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

9.zh: 对他说：「你往西罗亚池子里去洗。」（西罗亚翻出来就是「奉差遣」。）他去一洗，回头就看见了。
9.en: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

9.zh: 他的邻舍和那素常见他是讨饭的，就说：「这不是那从前坐着讨饭的人吗？」
9.en: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

9.zh: 有人说：「是他」；又有人说：「不是，却是像他。」他自己说：「是我。」
9.en: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

9.zh: 他们对他说：「你的眼睛是怎么开的呢？」
9.en: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

9.zh: 他回答说：「有一个人，名叫耶稣，他和泥抹我的眼睛，对我说：『你往西罗亚[池子]去洗。』我去一洗，就看见了。」
9.en: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

9.zh: 他们说：「那个人在哪里？」他说：「我不知道。」
9.en: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

9.zh: 他们把从前瞎眼的人带到法利赛人那里。
9.en: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

9.zh: 耶稣和泥开他眼睛的日子是安息日。
9.en: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

9.zh: 法利赛人也问他是怎么得看见的。瞎子对他们说：「他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看见了。」
9.en: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

9.zh: 法利赛人中有的说：「这个人不是从　神来的，因为他不守安息日。」又有人说：「一个罪人怎能行这样的神迹呢？」他们就起了纷争。
9.en: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

9.zh: 他们又对瞎子说：「他既然开了你的眼睛，你说他是怎样的人呢？」他说：「是个先知。」
9.en: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

9.zh: 犹太人不信他从前是瞎眼，后来能看见的，等到叫了他的父母来，
9.en: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

9.zh: 问他们说：「这是你们的儿子吗？你们说他生来是瞎眼的，如今怎么能看见了呢？」
9.en: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

9.zh: 他父母回答说：「他是我们的儿子，生来就瞎眼，这是我们知道的。
9.en: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

9.zh: 至于他如今怎么能看见，我们却不知道；是谁开了他的眼睛，我们也不知道。他已经成了人，你们问他吧，他自己必能说。」
9.en: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

9.zh: 他父母说这话，是怕犹太人；因为犹太人已经商议定了，若有认耶稣是基督的，要把他赶出会堂。
9.en: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

9.zh: 因此他父母说：「他已经成了人，你们问他吧。」
9.en: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

9.zh: 所以法利赛人第二次叫了那从前瞎眼的人来，对他说：「你该将荣耀归给　神，我们知道这人是个罪人。」
9.en: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

9.zh: 他说：「他是个罪人不是，我不知道；有一件事我知道，从前我是眼瞎的，如今能看见了。」
9.en: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

9.zh: 他们就问他说：「他向你做什么？是怎么开了你的眼睛呢？」
9.en: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

9.zh: 他回答说：「我方才告诉你们，你们不听，为什么又要听呢？莫非你们也要作他的门徒吗？」
9.en: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

9.zh: 他们就骂他说：「你是他的门徒；我们是摩西的门徒。
9.en: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

9.zh: 神对摩西说话是我们知道的；只是这个人，我们不知道他从哪里来！」
9.en: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

9.zh: 那人回答说：「他开了我的眼睛，你们竟不知道他从哪里来，这真是奇怪！
9.en: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

9.zh: 我们知道　神不听罪人，惟有敬奉　神、遵行他旨意的，　神才听他。
9.en: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

9.zh: 从创世以来，未曾听见有人把生来是瞎子的眼睛开了。
9.en: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

9.zh: 这人若不是从　神来的，什么也不能做。」
9.en: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

9.zh: 他们回答说：「你全然生在罪孽中，还要教训我们吗？」于是把他赶出去了。
9.en: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

9.zh: 耶稣听说他们把他赶出去，后来遇见他，就说：「你信　神的儿子吗？」
9.en: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

9.zh: 他回答说：「主啊，谁是　神的儿子，叫我信他呢？」
9.en: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「你已经看见他，现在和你说话的就是他。」
9.en: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

9.zh: 他说：「主啊，我信！」就拜耶稣。
9.en: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

9.zh: 耶稣说：「我为审判到这世上来，叫不能看见的，可以看见；能看见的，反瞎了眼。」
9.en: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

9.zh: 同他在那里的法利赛人听见这话，就说：「难道我们也瞎了眼吗？」
9.en: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

9.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们若瞎了眼，就没有罪了；但如今你们说『我们能看见』，[所以]你们的罪还在。」
9.en: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

10.zh: 「我实实在在地告诉你们，人进羊圈，不从门进去，倒从别处爬进去，那人就是贼，就是强盗。
10.en: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

10.zh: 从门进去的，才是羊的牧人。
10.en: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

10.zh: 看门的就给他开门；羊也听他的声音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊领出来。
10.en: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

10.zh: 既放出自己的羊来，就在前头走，羊也跟着他，因为认得他的声音。
10.en: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

10.zh: 羊不跟着生人；因为不认得他的声音，必要逃跑。」
10.en: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

10.zh: 耶稣将这比喻告诉他们，但他们不明白所说的是什么意思。
10.en: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

10.zh: 所以，耶稣又对他们说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，我就是羊的门。
10.en: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

10.zh: 凡在我以先来的都是贼，是强盗；羊却不听他们。
10.en: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

10.zh: 我就是门；凡从我进来的，必然得救，并且出入得草吃。
10.en: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

10.zh: 盗贼来，无非要偷窃，杀害，毁坏；我来了，是要叫羊得生命，并且得的更丰盛。
10.en: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

10.zh: 我是好牧人；好牧人为羊舍命。
10.en: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

10.zh: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看见狼来，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，赶散了羊群。
10.en: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

10.zh: 雇工[逃走]，因他是雇工，并不顾念羊。
10.en: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

10.zh: 我是好牧人；我认识我的羊，我的羊也认识我，
10.en: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

10.zh: 正如父认识我，我也认识父一样；并且我为羊舍命。
10.en: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

10.zh: 我另外有羊，不是这圈里的；我必须领他们来，他们也要听我的声音，并且要合成一群，归一个牧人了。
10.en: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

10.zh: 我父爱我；因我将命舍去，好再取回来。
10.en: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

10.zh: 没有人夺我的命去，是我自己舍的。我有权柄舍了，也有权柄取回来。这是我从我父所受的命令。」
10.en: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

10.zh: 犹太人为这些话又起了纷争。
10.en: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

10.zh: 内中有好些人说：「他是被鬼附着，而且疯了，为什么听他呢？」
10.en: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

10.zh: 又有人说：「这不是鬼附之人所说的话。鬼岂能叫瞎子的眼睛开了呢？」
10.en: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

10.zh: 在耶路撒冷有修殿节，是冬天的时候。
10.en: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

10.zh: 耶稣在殿里所罗门的廊下行走。
10.en: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

10.zh: 犹太人围着他，说：「你叫我们犹疑不定到几时呢？你若是基督，就明明地告诉我们。」
10.en: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

10.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我已经告诉你们，你们不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以为我作见证；
10.en: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

10.zh: 只是你们不信，因为你们不是我的羊。
10.en: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

10.zh: 我的羊听我的声音，我也认识他们，他们也跟着我。
10.en: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

10.zh: 我又赐给他们永生；他们永不灭亡，谁也不能从我手里把他们夺去。
10.en: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

10.zh: 我父把羊赐给我，他比万有都大，谁也不能从我父手里把他们夺去。
10.en: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

10.zh: 我与父原为一。」
10.en: I and the Father are one.”

10.zh: 犹太人又拿起石头来要打他。
10.en: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

10.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我从父显出许多善事给你们看，你们是为哪一件拿石头打我呢？」
10.en: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

10.zh: 犹太人回答说：「我们不是为善事拿石头打你，是为你说僭妄的话；又为你是个人，反将自己当作　神。」
10.en: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

10.zh: 耶稣说：「你们的律法上岂不是写着『我曾说你们是神』吗？
10.en: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

10.zh: 经上的话是不能废的；若那些承受　神道的人尚且称为神，
10.en: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

10.zh: 父所分别为圣、又差到世间来的，他自称是　神的儿子，你们还向他说『你说僭妄的话』吗？
10.en: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

10.zh: 我若不行我父的事，你们就不必信我；
10.en: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

10.zh: 我若行了，你们纵然不信我，也当信这些事，叫你们又知道又明白父在我里面，我也在父里面。」
10.en: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

10.zh: 他们又要拿他，他却逃出他们的手走了。
10.en: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

10.zh: 耶稣又往约旦河外去，到了约翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那里。
10.en: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

10.zh: 有许多人来到他那里。他们说：「约翰一件神迹没有行过，但约翰指着这人所说的一切话都是真的。」
10.en: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

10.zh: 在那里，信耶稣的人就多了。
10.en: Many believed in him there.

11.zh: 有一个患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是马利亚和她姊姊马大的村庄。
11.en: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

11.zh: 这马利亚就是那用香膏抹主，又用头发擦他脚的；患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。
11.en: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

11.zh: 她姊妹两个就打发人去见耶稣，说：「主啊，你所爱的人病了。」
11.en: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

11.zh: 耶稣听见，就说：「这病不至于死，乃是为　神的荣耀，叫　神的儿子因此得荣耀。」
11.en: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

11.zh: 耶稣素来爱马大和她妹子并拉撒路。
11.en: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

11.zh: 听见拉撒路病了，就在所居之地仍住了两天。
11.en: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

11.zh: 然后对门徒说：「我们再往犹太去吧。」
11.en: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

11.zh: 门徒说：「拉比，犹太人近来要拿石头打你，你还往那里去吗？」
11.en: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

11.zh: 耶稣回答说：「白日不是有十二小时吗？人在白日走路，就不至跌倒，因为看见这世上的光。
11.en: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

11.zh: 若在黑夜走路，就必跌倒，因为他没有光。」
11.en: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

11.zh: 耶稣说了这话，随后对他们说：「我们的朋友拉撒路睡了，我去叫醒他。」
11.en: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

11.zh: 门徒说：「主啊，他若睡了，就必好了。」
11.en: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

11.zh: 耶稣这话是指着他死说的，他们却以为是说照常睡了。
11.en: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

11.zh: 耶稣就明明地告诉他们说：「拉撒路死了。
11.en: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

11.zh: 我没有在那里就欢喜，这是为你们的缘故，好叫你们相信。[如今]我们可以往他那里去吧。」
11.en: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

11.zh: 多马，又称为低土马，就对那同作门徒的说：「我们也去和他同死吧。」
11.en: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

11.zh: 耶稣到了，就知道拉撒路在坟墓里已经四天了。
11.en: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

11.zh: 伯大尼离耶路撒冷不远，约有六里路。
11.en: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

11.zh: 有好些犹太人来看马大和马利亚，要为她们的兄弟安慰她们。
11.en: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

11.zh: 马大听见耶稣来了，就出去迎接他；马利亚却仍然坐在家里。
11.en: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

11.zh: 马大对耶稣说：「主啊，你若早在这里，我兄弟必不死。
11.en: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

11.zh: 就是现在，我也知道，你无论向　神求什么，　神也必赐给你。」
11.en: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

11.zh: 耶稣说：「你兄弟必然复活。」
11.en: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

11.zh: 马大说：「我知道在末日复活的时候，他必复活。」
11.en: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

11.zh: 耶稣对她说：「复活在我，生命也在我。信我的人虽然死了，也必复活；
11.en: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

11.zh: 凡活着信我的人必永远不死。你信这话吗？」
11.en: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

11.zh: 马大说：「主啊，是的，我信你是基督，是　神的儿子，就是那要临到世界的。」
11.en: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

11.zh: 马大说了这话，就回去暗暗地叫她妹子马利亚，说：「夫子来了，叫你。」
11.en: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

11.zh: 马利亚听见了，就急忙起来，到耶稣那里去。
11.en: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

11.zh: 那时，耶稣还没有进村子，仍在马大迎接他的地方。
11.en: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

11.zh: 那些同马利亚在家里安慰她的犹太人，见她急忙起来出去，就跟着她，以为她要往坟墓那里去哭。
11.en: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

11.zh: 马利亚到了耶稣那里，看见他，就俯伏在他脚前，说：「主啊，你若早在这里，我兄弟必不死。」
11.en: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

11.zh: 耶稣看见她哭，并看见与她同来的犹太人也哭，就心里悲叹，又甚忧愁，
11.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

11.zh: 便说：「你们把他安放在哪里？」他们回答说：「请主来看。」
11.en: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

11.zh: 耶稣哭了。
11.en: Jesus wept.

11.zh: 犹太人就说：「你看他爱这人是何等恳切。」
11.en: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

11.zh: 其中有人说：「他既然开了瞎子的眼睛，岂不能叫这人不死吗？」
11.en: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

11.zh: 耶稣又心里悲叹，来到坟墓前；那坟墓是个洞，有一块石头挡着。
11.en: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

11.zh: 耶稣说：「你们把石头挪开。」那死人的姊姊马大对他说：「主啊，他现在必是臭了，因为他[死了]已经四天了。」
11.en: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

11.zh: 耶稣说：「我不是对你说过，你若信，就必看见　神的荣耀吗？」
11.en: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

11.zh: 他们就把石头挪开。耶稣举目[望天]，说：「父啊，我感谢你，因为你已经听我。
11.en: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

11.zh: 我也知道你常听我，但我说这话是为周围站着的众人，叫他们信是你差了我来。」
11.en: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

11.zh: 说了这话，就大声呼叫说：「拉撒路出来！」
11.en: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

11.zh: 那死人就出来了，手脚裹着布，脸上包着手巾。耶稣对他们说：「解开，叫他走！」
11.en: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

11.zh: 那些来看马利亚的犹太人见了耶稣所做的事，就多有信他的；
11.en: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

11.zh: 但其中也有去见法利赛人的，将耶稣所做的事告诉他们。
11.en: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

11.zh: 祭司长和法利赛人聚集公会，说：「这人行好些神迹，我们怎么办呢？
11.en: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

11.zh: 若这样由着他，人人都要信他，罗马人也要来夺我们的地土和我们的百姓。」
11.en: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

11.zh: 内中有一个人，名叫该亚法，本年作大祭司，对他们说：「你们不知道什么。
11.en: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

11.zh: 独不想一个人替百姓死，免得通国灭亡，就是你们的益处。」
11.en: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

11.zh: 他这话不是出于自己，是因他本年作大祭司，所以预言耶稣将要替这一国死；
11.en: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

11.zh: 也不但替这一国死，并要将　神四散的子民都聚集归一。
11.en: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

11.zh: 从那日起，他们就商议要杀耶稣
11.en: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

11.zh: 所以，耶稣不再显然行在犹太人中间，就离开那里往靠近旷野的地方去，到了一座城，名叫以法莲，就在那里和门徒同住。
11.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

11.zh: 犹太人的逾越[节]近了，有许多人从乡下上耶路撒冷去，要在节前洁净自己。
11.en: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

11.zh: 他们就寻找耶稣，站在殿里彼此说：「你们的意思如何，他不来过节吗？」
11.en: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

11.zh: 那时，祭司长和法利赛人早已吩咐说，若有人知道耶稣在哪里，就要报明，好去拿他。
11.en: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

12.zh: 逾越节前六日，耶稣来到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路从死里复活之处。
12.en: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

12.zh: 有人在那里给耶稣预备筵席；马大伺候，拉撒路也在那同耶稣坐席的人中。
12.en: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

12.zh: 马利亚就拿着一斤极贵的真哪哒香膏，抹耶稣的脚，又用自己头发去擦，屋里就满了膏的香气。
12.en: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

12.zh: 有一个门徒，就是那将要卖耶稣的加略人犹大，
12.en: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

12.zh: 说：「这香膏为什么不卖三十两银子周济穷人呢？」
