12.en: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

12.zh: 他说这话，并不是挂念穷人，乃因他是个贼，又带着钱囊，常取其中所存的。
12.en: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

12.zh: 耶稣说：「由她吧！她是为我安葬之日存留的。
12.en: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

12.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在，只是你们不常有我。」
12.en: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

12.zh: 有许多犹太人知道耶稣在那里，就来了，不但是为耶稣的缘故，也是要看他从死里所复活的拉撒路。
12.en: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

12.zh: 但祭司长商议连拉撒路也要杀了；
12.en: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

12.zh: 因有好些犹太人为拉撒路的缘故，回去信了耶稣。
12.en: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

12.zh: 第二天，有许多上来过节的人听见耶稣将到耶路撒冷，
12.en: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

12.zh: 就拿着棕树枝出去迎接他，喊着说： 和散那！ 奉主名来的以色列王是应当称颂的！
12.en: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

12.zh: 耶稣得了一个驴驹，就骑上，如[经]上所记的说：
12.en: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

12.zh: 锡安的民哪，不要惧怕！ 你的王骑着驴驹来了。
12.en: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

12.zh: 这些事门徒起先不明白，等到耶稣得了荣耀以后才想起这话是指着他写的，并且众人果然向他这样行了。
12.en: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

12.zh: 当耶稣呼唤拉撒路，叫他从死复活出坟墓的时候，同耶稣在那里的众人就作见证。
12.en: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

12.zh: 众人因听见耶稣行了这神迹，就去迎接他。
12.en: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

12.zh: 法利赛人彼此说：「看哪，你们是徒劳无益，世人都随从他去了。」
12.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

12.zh: 那时，上来过节礼拜的人中，有几个希腊人。
12.en: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

12.zh: 他们来见加利利、伯赛大的腓力，求他说：「先生，我们愿意见耶稣。」
12.en: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

12.zh: 腓力去告诉安得烈，安得烈同腓力去告诉耶稣。
12.en: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

12.zh: 耶稣说：「人子得荣耀的时候到了。
12.en: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

12.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，一粒麦子不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒，若是死了，就结出许多子粒来。
12.en: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

12.zh: 爱惜自己生命的，就失丧生命；在这世上恨恶自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。
12.en: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

12.zh: 若有人服事我，就当跟从我；我在哪里，服事我的人也要在那里；若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。」
12.en: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

12.zh: 「我现在心里忧愁，我说什么才好呢？父啊，救我脱离这时候；但我原是为这时候来的。
12.en: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

12.zh: 父啊，愿你荣耀你的名！」当时就有声音从天上来，说：「我已经荣耀了我的名，还要再荣耀。」
12.en: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

12.zh: 站在旁边的众人听见，就说：「打雷了。」还有人说：「有天使对他说话。」
12.en: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

12.zh: 耶稣说：「这声音不是为我，是为你们来的。
12.en: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

12.zh: 现在这世界受审判，这世界的王要被赶出去。
12.en: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

12.zh: 我若从地上被举起来，就要吸引万人来归我。」
12.en: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

12.zh: 耶稣这话原是指着自己将要怎样死说的。
12.en: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

12.zh: 众人回答说：「我们听见律法上有话说，基督是永存的，你怎么说『人子必须被举起来』呢？这人子是谁呢？」
12.en: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

12.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「光在你们中间还有不多的时候，应当趁着有光行走，免得黑暗临到你们；那在黑暗里行走的，不知道往何处去。
12.en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

12.zh: 你们应当趁着有光，信从这光，使你们成为光明之子。」 耶稣说了这话，就离开他们隐藏了。
12.en: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

12.zh: 他虽然在他们面前行了许多神迹，他们还是不信他。
12.en: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

12.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说： 主啊，我们所传的有谁信呢？ 主的膀臂向谁显露呢？
12.en: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

12.zh: 他们所以不能信，因为以赛亚又说：
12.en: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

12.zh: 主叫他们瞎了眼， 硬了心， 免得他们眼睛看见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医治他们。
12.en: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

12.zh: 以赛亚因为看见他的荣耀，就指着他说这话。
12.en: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

12.zh: 虽然如此，官长中却有好些信他的，只因法利赛人的缘故，就不承认，恐怕被赶出会堂。
12.en: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

12.zh: 这是因他们爱人的荣耀过于爱　神的荣耀。
12.en: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

12.zh: 耶稣大声说：「信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我来的。
12.en: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

12.zh: 人看见我，就是看见那差我来的。
12.en: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

12.zh: 我到世上来，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗里。
12.en: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

12.zh: 若有人听见我的话不遵守，我不审判他。我来本不是要审判世界，乃是要拯救世界。
12.en: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

12.zh: 弃绝我、不领受我话的人，有审判他的—就是我所讲的道在末日要审判他。
12.en: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

12.zh: 因为我没有凭着自己讲，惟有差我来的父已经给我命令，叫我说什么，讲什么。
12.en: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

12.zh: 我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此，我所讲的话正是照着父对我所说的。」
12.en: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

13.zh: 逾越节以前，耶稣知道自己离世归父的时候到了。他既然爱世间属自己的人，就爱他们到底。
13.en: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

13.zh: 吃晚饭的时候，魔鬼已将卖耶稣的意思放在西门的儿子加略人犹大心里。
13.en: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

13.zh: 耶稣知道父已将万有交在他手里，且知道自己是从　神出来的，又要归到　神那里去，
13.en: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

13.zh: 就离席站起来，脱了衣服，拿一条手巾束腰，
13.en: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

13.zh: 随后把水倒在盆里，就洗门徒的脚，并用自己所束的手巾擦干。
13.en: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

13.zh: 挨到西门·彼得，彼得对他说：「主啊，你洗我的脚吗？」
13.en: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

13.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我所做的，你如今不知道，后来必明白。」
13.en: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

13.zh: 彼得说：「你永不可洗我的脚！」耶稣说：「我若不洗你，你就与我无分了。」
13.en: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

13.zh: 西门·彼得说：「主啊，不但我的脚，连手和头也要洗。」
13.en: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

13.zh: 耶稣说：「凡洗过澡的人，只要把脚一洗，全身就干净了。你们是干净的，然而不都是干净的。」
13.en: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

13.zh: 耶稣原知道要卖他的是谁，所以说：「你们不都是干净的。」
13.en: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

13.zh: 耶稣洗完了他们的脚，就穿上衣服，又坐下，对他们说：「我向你们所做的，你们明白吗？
13.en: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

13.zh: 你们称呼我夫子，称呼我主，你们说的不错，我本来是。
13.en: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

13.zh: 我是你们的主，你们的夫子，尚且洗你们的脚，你们也当彼此洗脚。
13.en: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

13.zh: 我给你们作了榜样，叫你们照着我向你们所做的去做。
13.en: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

13.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，仆人不能大于主人，差人也不能大于差他的人。
13.en: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

13.zh: 你们既知道这事，若是去行就有福了。
13.en: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

13.zh: 我这话不是指着你们众人说的，我知道我所拣选的是谁。现在要应验经上的话，说：『同我吃饭的人用脚踢我。』
13.en: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

13.zh: 如今事情还没有成就，我要先告诉你们，叫你们到事情成就的时候可以信我是[基督]。
13.en: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

13.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。」
13.en: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

13.zh: 耶稣说了这话，心里忧愁，就明说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。」
13.en: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

13.zh: 门徒彼此对看，猜不透所说的是谁。
13.en: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

13.zh: 有一个门徒，是耶稣所爱的，侧身挨近耶稣的怀里。
13.en: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

13.zh: 西门·彼得点头对他说：「你告诉我们，主是指着谁说的。」
13.en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

13.zh: 那门徒便就势靠着耶稣的胸膛，问他说：「主啊，是谁呢？」
13.en: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

13.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我蘸一点饼给谁，就是谁。」耶稣就蘸了一点饼，递给加略人西门的儿子犹大。
13.en: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

13.zh: 他吃了以后，撒但就入了他的心。耶稣便对他说：「你所做的，快做吧！」
13.en: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

13.zh: 同席的人没有一个知道是为什么对他说这话。
13.en: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

13.zh: 有人因犹大带着钱囊，以为耶稣是对他说：「你去买我们过节所应用的东西」，或是叫他拿什么周济穷人。
13.en: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

13.zh: 犹大受了那点饼，立刻就出去。那时候是夜间了。
13.en: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

13.zh: 他既出去，耶稣就说：「如今人子得了荣耀，　神在人子身上也得了荣耀。
13.en: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

13.zh: 神要因自己荣耀人子，并且要快快地荣耀他。
13.en: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

13.zh: 小子们，我还有不多的时候与你们同在；后来你们要找我，但我所去的地方你们不能到。这话我曾对犹太人说过，如今也照样对你们说。
13.en: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

13.zh: 我赐给你们一条新命令，乃是叫你们彼此相爱；我怎样爱你们，你们也要怎样相爱。
13.en: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

13.zh: 你们若有彼此相爱的心，众人因此就认出你们是我的门徒了。」
13.en: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

13.zh: 西门·彼得问耶稣说：「主往哪里去？」耶稣回答说：「我所去的地方，你现在不能跟我去，后来却要跟我去。」
13.en: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

13.zh: 彼得说：「主啊，我为什么现在不能跟你去？我愿意为你舍命！」
13.en: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

13.zh: 耶稣说：「你愿意为我舍命吗？我实实在在地告诉你，鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」
13.en: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

14.zh: 「你们心里不要忧愁；你们信　神，也当信我。
14.en: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

14.zh: 在我父的家里有许多住处；若是没有，我就早已告诉你们了。我去原是为你们预备地方去。
14.en: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

14.zh: 我若去为你们预备了地方，就必再来接你们到我那里去，我在哪里，叫你们也在那里。
14.en: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

14.zh: 我往哪里去，你们知道；那条路，你们也知道。」
14.en: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

14.zh: 多马对他说：「主啊，我们不知道你往哪里去，怎么知道那条路呢？」
14.en: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

14.zh: 耶稣说：「我就是道路、真理、生命；若不借着我，没有人能到父那里去。
14.en: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

14.zh: 你们若认识我，也就认识我的父。从今以后，你们认识他，并且已经看见他。」
14.en: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

14.zh: 腓力对他说：「求主将父显给我们看，我们就知足了。」
14.en: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

14.zh: 耶稣对他说：「腓力，我与你们同在这样长久，你还不认识我吗？人看见了我，就是看见了父；你怎么说『将父显给我们看』呢？
14.en: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

14.zh: 我在父里面，父在我里面，你不信吗？我对你们所说的话，不是凭着自己说的，乃是住在我里面的父做他自己的事。
14.en: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

14.zh: 你们当信我，我在父里面，父在我里面；即或不信，也当因我所做的事信我。
14.en: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

14.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，并且要做比这更大的事，因为我往父那里去。
14.en: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

14.zh: 你们奉我的名无论求什么，我必成就，叫父因儿子得荣耀。
14.en: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

14.zh: 你们若奉我的名求什么，我必成就。」
14.en: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

14.zh: 「你们若爱我，就必遵守我的命令。
14.en: If you love me, keep my commandments.

14.zh: 我要求父，父就另外赐给你们一位保惠师，叫他永远与你们同在，
14.en: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

14.zh: 就是真理的[圣]灵，乃世人不能接受的；因为不见他，也不认识他。你们却认识他，因他常与你们同在，也要在你们里面。
14.en: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

14.zh: 我不撇下你们为孤儿，我必到你们这里来。
14.en: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

14.zh: 还有不多的时候，世人不再看见我，你们却看见我；因为我活着，你们也要活着。
14.en: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

14.zh: 到那日，你们就知道我在父里面，你们在我里面，我也在你们里面。
14.en: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

14.zh: 有了我的命令又遵守的，这人就是爱我的；爱我的必蒙我父爱他，我也要爱他，并且要向他显现。」
14.en: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

14.zh: 犹大（不是加略人犹大）问耶稣说：「主啊，为什么要向我们显现，不向世人显现呢？」
14.en: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

14.zh: 耶稣回答说：「人若爱我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必爱他，并且我们要到他那里去，与他同住。
14.en: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

14.zh: 不爱我的人就不遵守我的道。你们所听见的道不是我的，乃是差我来之父的道。
14.en: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

14.zh: 「我还与你们同住的时候，已将这些话对你们说了。
14.en: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

14.zh: 但保惠师，就是父因我的名所要差来的圣灵，他要将一切的事指教你们，并且要叫你们想起我对你们所说的一切话。
14.en: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

14.zh: 我留下平安给你们；我将我的平安赐给你们。我所赐的，不像世人所赐的。你们心里不要忧愁，也不要胆怯。
14.en: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

14.zh: 你们听见我对你们说了，我去还要到你们这里来。你们若爱我，因我到父那里去，就必喜乐，因为父是比我大的。
14.en: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

14.zh: 现在事情还没有成就，我预先告诉你们，叫你们到事情成就的时候就可以信。
14.en: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

14.zh: 以后我不再和你们多说话，因为这世界的王将到。他在我里面是毫无所有；
14.en: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

14.zh: 但要叫世人知道我爱父，并且父怎样吩咐我，我就怎样行。起来，我们走吧！」
14.en: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

15.zh: 「我是真葡萄树，我父是栽培的人。
15.en: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

15.zh: 凡属我不结果子的枝子，他就剪去；凡结果子的，他就修理干净，使枝子结果子更多。
15.en: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

15.zh: 现在你们因我讲给你们的道，已经干净了。
15.en: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

15.zh: 你们要常在我里面，我也常在你们里面。枝子若不常在葡萄树上，自己就不能结果子；你们若不常在我里面，也是这样。
15.en: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

15.zh: 我是葡萄树，你们是枝子。常在我里面的，我也常在他里面，这人就多结果子；因为离了我，你们就不能做什么。
15.en: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

15.zh: 人若不常在我里面，就像枝子丢在外面枯干，人拾起来，扔在火里烧了。
15.en: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

15.zh: 你们若常在我里面，我的话也常在你们里面，凡你们所愿意的，祈求，就给你们成就。
15.en: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

15.zh: 你们多结果子，我父就因此得荣耀，你们也就是我的门徒了。
15.en: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

15.zh: 我爱你们，正如父爱我一样；你们要常在我的爱里。
15.en: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

15.zh: 你们若遵守我的命令，就常在我的爱里，正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的爱里。
15.en: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

15.zh: 「这些事我已经对你们说了，是要叫我的喜乐存在你们心里，并叫你们的喜乐可以满足。
15.en: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

15.zh: 你们要彼此相爱，像我爱你们一样；这就是我的命令。
15.en: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

15.zh: 人为朋友舍命，人的爱心没有比这个大的。
15.en: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

15.zh: 你们若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。
15.en: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

15.zh: 以后我不再称你们为仆人，因仆人不知道主人所做的事。我乃称你们为朋友；因我从我父所听见的，已经都告诉你们了。
15.en: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

15.zh: 不是你们拣选了我，是我拣选了你们，并且分派你们去结果子，叫你们的果子常存，使你们奉我的名，无论向父求什么，他就赐给你们。
15.en: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

15.zh: 我这样吩咐你们，是要叫你们彼此相爱。」
15.en: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

15.zh: 「世人若恨你们，你们知道，恨你们以先已经恨我了。
15.en: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

15.zh: 你们若属世界，世界必爱属自己的；只因你们不属世界，乃是我从世界中拣选了你们，所以世界就恨你们。
15.en: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

15.zh: 你们要记念我从前对你们所说的话：『仆人不能大于主人。』他们若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你们；若遵守了我的话，也要遵守你们的话。
15.en: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

15.zh: 但他们因我的名要向你们行这一切的事，因为他们不认识那差我来的。
15.en: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

15.zh: 我若没有来教训他们，他们就没有罪；但如今他们的罪无可推诿了。
15.en: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

15.zh: 恨我的，也恨我的父。
15.en: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

15.zh: 我若没有在他们中间行过别人未曾行的事，他们就没有罪；但如今连我与我的父，他们也看见也恨恶了。
15.en: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

15.zh: 这要应验他们律法上所写的话，说：『他们无故地恨我。』
15.en: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

15.zh: 但我要从父那里差保惠师来，就是从父出来真理的圣灵；他来了，就要为我作见证。
15.en: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

15.zh: 你们也要作见证，因为你们从起头就与我同在。」
15.en: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

16.zh: 「我已将这些事告诉你们，使你们不至于跌倒。
16.en: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

16.zh: 人要把你们赶出会堂，并且时候将到，凡杀你们的就以为是事奉　神。
16.en: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

16.zh: 他们这样行，是因未曾认识父，也未曾认识我。
16.en: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

16.zh: 我将这事告诉你们，是叫你们到了时候可以想起我对你们说过了。」 「我起先没有将这事告诉你们，因为我与你们同在。
16.en: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

16.zh: 现今我往差我来的[父]那里去，你们中间并没有人问我：『你往哪里去？』
16.en: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

16.zh: 只因我将这事告诉你们，你们就满心忧愁。
16.en: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

16.zh: 然而，我将真情告诉你们，我去是与你们有益的；我若不去，保惠师就不到你们这里来；我若去，就差他来。
16.en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

16.zh: 他既来了，就要叫世人为罪、为义、为审判，自己责备自己。
16.en: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

16.zh: 为罪，是因他们不信我；
16.en: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

16.zh: 为义，是因我往父那里去，你们就不再见我；
16.en: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

16.zh: 为审判，是因这世界的王受了审判。
16.en: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

16.zh: 「我还有好些事要告诉你们，但你们现在担当不了。
16.en: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

16.zh: 只等真理的圣灵来了，他要引导你们明白一切的真理；因为他不是凭自己说的，乃是把他所听见的都说出来，并要把将来的事告诉你们。
16.en: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

16.zh: 他要荣耀我，因为他要将受于我的告诉你们。
16.en: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

16.zh: 凡父所有的，都是我的；所以我说，他要将受于我的告诉你们。」
16.en: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

16.zh: 「等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我。」
16.en: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

16.zh: 有几个门徒就彼此说：「他对我们说：『等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我』；又[说]：『因我往父那里去。』这是什么意思呢？」
16.en: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

16.zh: 门徒彼此说：「他说『等不多时』到底是什么意思呢？我们不明白他所说的话。」
16.en: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

16.zh: 耶稣看出他们要问他，就说：「我说『等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我』，你们为这话彼此相问吗？
16.en: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

16.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，你们将要痛哭、哀号，世人倒要喜乐；你们将要忧愁，然而你们的忧愁要变为喜乐。
16.en: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

16.zh: 妇人生产的时候就忧愁，因为她的时候到了；既生了孩子，就不再记念那苦楚，因为欢喜世上生了一个人。
16.en: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

16.zh: 你们现在也是忧愁，但我要再见你们，你们的心就喜乐了；这喜乐也没有人能夺去。
16.en: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

16.zh: 到那日，你们什么也就不问我了。我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若向父求什么，他必因我的名赐给你们。
16.en: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

16.zh: 向来你们没有奉我的名求什么，如今你们求，就必得着，叫你们的喜乐可以满足。」
16.en: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

16.zh: 「这些事，我是用比喻对你们说的；时候将到，我不再用比喻对你们说，乃要将父明明地告诉你们。
16.en: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

16.zh: 到那日，你们要奉我的名祈求；我并不对你们说，我要为你们求父。
16.en: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

16.zh: 父自己爱你们；因为你们已经爱我，又信我是从父出来的。
16.en: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

16.zh: 我从父出来，到了世界；我又离开世界，往父那里去。」
16.en: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

16.zh: 门徒说：「如今你是明说，并不用比喻了。
16.en: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

16.zh: 现在我们晓得你凡事都知道，也不用人问你，因此我们信你是从　神出来的。」
16.en: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

16.zh: 耶稣说：「现在你们信吗？
16.en: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

16.zh: 看哪，时候将到，且是已经到了，你们要分散，各归自己的地方去，留下我独自一人；其实我不是独自一人，因为有父与我同在。
16.en: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

16.zh: 我将这些事告诉你们，是要叫你们在我里面有平安。在世上，你们有苦难；但你们可以放心，我已经胜了世界。」
16.en: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

17.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就举目望天，说：「父啊，时候到了，愿你荣耀你的儿子，使儿子也荣耀你；
17.en: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

17.zh: 正如你曾赐给他权柄管理凡有血气的，叫他将永生赐给你所赐给他的人。
17.en: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

17.zh: 认识你—独一的真神，并且认识你所差来的耶稣基督，这就是永生。
17.en: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

17.zh: 我在地上已经荣耀你，你所托付我的事，我已成全了。
17.en: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

17.zh: 父啊，现在求你使我同你享荣耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的荣耀。
17.en: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

17.zh: 「你从世上赐给我的人，我已将你的名显明与他们。他们本是你的，你将他们赐给我，他们也遵守了你的道。
17.en: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

17.zh: 如今他们知道，凡你所赐给我的，都是从你那里来的；
17.en: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

17.zh: 因为你所赐给我的道，我已经赐给他们，他们也领受了，又确实知道，我是从你出来的，并且信你差了我来。
17.en: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

17.zh: 我为他们祈求，不为世人祈求，却为你所赐给我的人祈求，因他们本是你的。
17.en: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

17.zh: 凡是我的，都是你的；你的也是我的，并且我因他们得了荣耀。
17.en: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

17.zh: 从今以后，我不在世上，他们却在世上；我往你那里去。圣父啊，求你因你所赐给我的名保守他们，叫他们合而为一像我们一样。
17.en: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

17.zh: 我与他们同在的时候，因你所赐给我的名保守了他们，我也护卫了他们；其中除了那灭亡之子，没有一个灭亡的，好叫经上的话得应验。
17.en: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

17.zh: 现在我往你那里去，我还在世上说这话，是叫他们心里充满我的喜乐。
17.en: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

17.zh: 我已将你的道赐给他们。世界又恨他们；因为他们不属世界，正如我不属世界一样。
17.en: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

17.zh: 我不求你叫他们离开世界，只求你保守他们脱离那恶者。
17.en: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

17.zh: 他们不属世界，正如我不属世界一样。
17.en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

17.zh: 求你用真理使他们成圣；你的道就是真理。
17.en: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

17.zh: 你怎样差我到世上，我也照样差他们到世上。
17.en: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

17.zh: 我为他们的缘故，自己分别为圣，叫他们也因真理成圣。
17.en: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

17.zh: 「我不但为这些人祈求，也为那些因他们的话信我的人祈求，
17.en: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

17.zh: 使他们都合而为一。正如你父在我里面，我在你里面，使他们也在我们里面，叫世人可以信你差了我来。
17.en: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

17.zh: 你所赐给我的荣耀，我已赐给他们，使他们合而为一，像我们合而为一。
17.en: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

17.zh: 我在他们里面，你在我里面，使他们完完全全地合而为一，叫世人知道你差了我来，也知道你爱他们如同爱我一样。
17.en: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

17.zh: 父啊，我在哪里，愿你所赐给我的人也同我在那里，叫他们看见你所赐给我的荣耀；因为创立世界以前，你已经爱我了。
17.en: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

17.zh: 公义的父啊，世人未曾认识你，我却认识你；这些人也知道你差了我来。
17.en: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

17.zh: 我已将你的名指示他们，还要指示他们，使你所爱我的爱在他们里面，我也在他们里面。」
17.en: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

18.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就同门徒出去，过了汲沦溪。在那里有一个园子，他和门徒进去了。
18.en: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

18.zh: 卖耶稣的犹大也知道那地方，因为耶稣和门徒屡次上那里去聚集。
18.en: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

18.zh: 犹大领了一队兵，和祭司长并法利赛人的差役，拿着灯笼、火把、兵器，就来到园里。
18.en: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

18.zh: 耶稣知道将要临到自己的一切事，就出来对他们说：「你们找谁？」
18.en: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

18.zh: 他们回答说：「找拿撒勒人耶稣。」耶稣说：「我就是！」卖他的犹大也同他们站在那里。
18.en: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

18.zh: 耶稣一说「我就是」，他们就退后倒在地上。
18.en: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

18.zh: 他又问他们说：「你们找谁？」他们说：「找拿撒勒人耶稣。」
18.en: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

18.zh: 耶稣说：「我已经告诉你们，我就是。你们若找我，就让这些人去吧。」
18.en: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

18.zh: 这要应验耶稣从前的话，说：「你所赐给我的人，我没有失落一个。」
18.en: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

18.zh: 西门·彼得带着一把刀，就拔出来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那仆人名叫马勒古。
18.en: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

18.zh: 耶稣就对彼得说：「收刀入鞘吧，我父所给我的那杯，我岂可不喝呢？」
18.en: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

18.zh: 那队兵和千夫长，并犹太人的差役就拿住耶稣，把他捆绑了，
18.en: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

18.zh: 先带到亚那面前，因为亚那是本年作大祭司该亚法的岳父。
18.en: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

18.zh: 这该亚法就是从前向犹太人发议论说「一个人替百姓死是有益的」那位。
18.en: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

18.zh: 西门·彼得跟着耶稣，还有一个门徒跟着。那门徒是大祭司所认识的，他就同耶稣进了大祭司的院子。
18.en: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

18.zh: 彼得却站在门外。大祭司所认识的那个门徒出来，和看门的使女说了一声，就领彼得进去。
18.en: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

18.zh: 那看门的使女对彼得说：「你不也是这人的门徒吗？」他说：「我不是。」
18.en: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

18.zh: 仆人和差役因为天冷，就生了炭火，站在那里烤火；彼得也同他们站着烤火。
18.en: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

18.zh: 大祭司就以耶稣的门徒和他的教训盘问他。
18.en: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

18.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我从来是明明地对世人说话。我常在会堂和殿里，就是犹太人聚集的地方教训人；我在暗地里并没有说什么。
18.en: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

18.zh: 你为什么问我呢？可以问那听见的人，我对他们说的是什么；我所说的，他们都知道。」
18.en: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

18.zh: 耶稣说了这话，旁边站着的一个差役用手掌打他，说：「你这样回答大祭司吗？」
18.en: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

18.zh: 耶稣说：「我若说的不是，你可以指证那不是；我若说的是，你为什么打我呢？」
18.en: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

18.zh: 亚那就把耶稣解到大祭司该亚法那里，仍是捆着解去的。
18.en: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

18.zh: 西门·彼得正站着烤火，有人对他说：「你不也是他的门徒吗？」彼得不承认，说：「我不是。」
18.en: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

18.zh: 有大祭司的一个仆人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的亲属，说：「我不是看见你同他在园子里吗？」
18.en: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

18.zh: 彼得又不承认。立时鸡就叫了。
18.en: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

18.zh: 众人将耶稣从该亚法那里往衙门内解去，那时天还早。他们自己却不进衙门，恐怕染了污秽，不能吃逾越[节的筵席]。
18.en: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

18.zh: 彼拉多就出来，到他们那里，说：「你们告这人是为什么事呢？」
18.en: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

18.zh: 他们回答说：「这人若不是作恶的，我们就不把他交给你。」
18.en: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

18.zh: 彼拉多说：「你们自己带他去，按着你们的律法审问他吧。」犹太人说：「我们没有杀人的权柄。」
18.en: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

18.zh: 这要应验耶稣所说自己将要怎样死的话了。
18.en: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

18.zh: 彼拉多又进了衙门，叫耶稣来，对他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」
18.en: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

18.zh: 耶稣回答说：「这话是你自己说的，还是别人论我对你说的呢？」
18.en: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

18.zh: 彼拉多说：「我岂是犹太人呢？你本国的人和祭司长把你交给我。你做了什么事呢？」
18.en: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

18.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我的国不属这世界；我的国若属这世界，我的臣仆必要争战，使我不至于被交给犹太人。只是我的国不属这世界。」
18.en: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

18.zh: 彼拉多就对他说：「这样，你是王吗？」耶稣回答说：「你说我是王。我为此而生，也为此来到世间，特为给真理作见证。凡属真理的人就听我的话。」
18.en: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

18.zh: 彼拉多说：「真理是什么呢？」 说了这话，又出来到犹太人那里，对他们说：「我查不出他有什么罪来。
18.en: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

18.zh: 但你们有个规矩，在逾越节要我给你们释放一个人，你们要我给你们释放犹太人的王吗？」
18.en: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

18.zh: 他们又喊着说：「不要这人，要巴拉巴！」这巴拉巴是个强盗。
18.en: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

19.zh: 当下彼拉多将耶稣鞭打了。
19.en: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

19.zh: 兵丁用荆棘编做冠冕戴在他头上，给他穿上紫袍，
19.en: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

19.zh: 又挨近他，说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」他们就用手掌打他。
19.en: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

19.zh: 彼拉多又出来对众人说：「我带他出来见你们，叫你们知道我查不出他有什么罪来。」
19.en: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

19.zh: 耶稣出来，戴着荆棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。[彼拉多]对他们说：「你们看这个人！」
19.en: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

19.zh: 祭司长和差役看见他，就喊着说：「钉他十字架！钉他十字架！」彼拉多说：「你们自己把他钉十字架吧！我查不出他有什么罪来。」
19.en: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

19.zh: 犹太人回答说：「我们有律法，按那律法，他是该死的，因他以自己为　神的儿子。」
19.en: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

19.zh: 彼拉多听见这话，越发害怕，
19.en: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

19.zh: 又进衙门，对耶稣说：「你是哪里来的？」耶稣却不回答。
19.en: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

19.zh: 彼拉多说：「你不对我说话吗？你岂不知我有权柄释放你，也有权柄把你钉十字架吗？」
19.en: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

19.zh: 耶稣回答说：「若不是从上头赐给你的，你就毫无权柄办我。所以，把我交给你的那人罪更重了。」
19.en: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

19.zh: 从此，彼拉多想要释放耶稣，无奈犹太人喊着说：「你若释放这个人，就不是凯撒的忠臣。凡以自己为王的，就是背叛凯撒了。」
19.en: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

19.zh: 彼拉多听见这话，就带耶稣出来，到了一个地方，名叫「铺华石处」，希伯来话叫厄巴大，就在那里坐堂。
19.en: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

19.zh: 那日是预备逾越[节]的日子，约有午正。彼拉多对犹太人说：「看哪，这是你们的王！」
19.en: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

19.zh: 他们喊着说：「除掉他！除掉他！钉他在十字架上！」彼拉多说：「我可以把你们的王钉十字架吗？」祭司长回答说：「除了凯撒，我们没有王。」
19.en: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

19.zh: 于是彼拉多将耶稣交给他们去钉十字架。
19.en: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

19.zh: 他们就把耶稣带了去。耶稣背着自己的十字架出来，到了一个地方，名叫「髑髅地」，希伯来话叫各各他。
19.en: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

19.zh: 他们就在那里钉他在十字架上，还有两个人和他一同钉着，一边一个，耶稣在中间。
19.en: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

19.zh: 彼拉多又[用牌子]写了一个名号，安在十字架上，写的是：「犹太人的王，拿撒勒人耶稣。」
19.en: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

19.zh: 有许多犹太人念这名号；因为耶稣被钉十字架的地方与城相近，并且是用希伯来、罗马、希腊三样文字写的。
19.en: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

19.zh: 犹太人的祭司长就对彼拉多说：「不要写『犹太人的王』，要写『他自己说：我是犹太人的王』。」
19.en: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

19.zh: 彼拉多说：「我所写的，我已经写上了。」
19.en: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

19.zh: 兵丁既然将耶稣钉在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分为四分，每兵一分；又拿他的里衣，这件里衣原来没有缝儿，是上下一片织成的。
19.en: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

19.zh: 他们就彼此说：「我们不要撕开，只要拈阄，看谁得着。」这要应验经上的话说： 他们分了我的外衣， 为我的里衣拈阄。 兵丁果然做了这事。
19.en: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

19.zh: 站在耶稣十字架旁边的，有他母亲与他母亲的姊妹，并革罗罢的妻子马利亚，和抹大拉的马利亚。
19.en: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

19.zh: 耶稣见母亲和他所爱的那门徒站在旁边，就对他母亲说：「母亲，看，你的儿子！」
19.en: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

19.zh: 又对那门徒说：「看，你的母亲！」从此，那门徒就接她到自己家里去了。
19.en: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

19.zh: 这事以后，耶稣知道各样的事已经成了，为要使经上的话应验，就说：「我渴了。」
19.en: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

19.zh: 有一个器皿盛满了醋，放在那里；他们就拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在牛膝草上，送到他口。
19.en: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

19.zh: 耶稣尝了那醋，就说：「成了！」便低下头，将灵魂交付　[神]了。
19.en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

19.zh: 犹太人因这日是预备日，又因那安息日是个大日，就求彼拉多叫人打断他们的腿，把他们拿去，免得尸首当安息日留在十字架上。
19.en: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

19.zh: 于是兵丁来，把头一个人的腿，并与耶稣同钉第二个人的腿，都打断了。
19.en: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

19.zh: 只是来到耶稣那里，见他已经死了，就不打断他的腿。
19.en: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

19.zh: 惟有一个兵拿枪扎他的肋旁，随即有血和水流出来。
19.en: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

19.zh: 看见[这事]的那人就作见证—他的见证也是真的，并且他知道自己所说的是真的—叫你们也可以信。
19.en: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

19.zh: 这些事成了，为要应验经上的话说：「他的骨头一根也不可折断。」
19.en: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

19.zh: 经上又有一句说：「他们要仰望自己所扎的人。」
19.en: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

19.zh: 这些事以后，有亚利马太人约瑟，是耶稣的门徒，只因怕犹太人，就暗暗地作门徒。他来求彼拉多，要把耶稣的身体领去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶稣的身体领去了。
19.en: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

19.zh: 又有尼哥德慕，就是先前夜里去见耶稣的，带着没药和沉香约有一百斤前来。
19.en: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

19.zh: 他们就照犹太人殡葬的规矩，把耶稣的身体用细麻布加上香料裹好了。
19.en: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

19.zh: 在耶稣钉十字架的地方有一个园子，园子里有一座新坟墓，是从来没有葬过人的。
19.en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

19.zh: 只因是犹太人的预备日，又因那坟墓近，他们就把耶稣安放在那里。
19.en: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.

20.zh: 七日的第一日清早，天还黑的时候，抹大拉的马利亚来到坟墓那里，看见石头从坟墓挪开了，
20.en: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

20.zh: 就跑来见西门·彼得和耶稣所爱的那个门徒，对他们说：「有人把主从坟墓里挪了去，我们不知道放在哪里。」
20.en: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

20.zh: 彼得和那门徒就出来，往坟墓那里去。
20.en: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

20.zh: 两个人同跑，那门徒比彼得跑得更快，先到了坟墓，
20.en: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

20.zh: 低头往里看，就见细麻布还放在那里，只是没有进去。
20.en: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

20.zh: 西门·彼得随后也到了，进坟墓里去，就看见细麻布还放在那里，
20.en: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

20.zh: 又看见耶稣的裹头巾没有和细麻布放在一处，是另在一处卷着。
20.en: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

20.zh: 先到坟墓的那门徒也进去，看见就信了。（
20.en: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

20.zh: 因为他们还不明白圣经的[意思]，就是耶稣必要从死里复活。）
20.en: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

20.zh: 于是两个门徒回自己的住处去了。
20.en: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

20.zh: 马利亚却站在坟墓外面哭。哭的时候，低头往坟墓里看，
20.en: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

20.zh: 就见两个天使，穿着白衣，在安放耶稣身体的地方坐着，一个在头，一个在脚。
20.en: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

20.zh: 天使对她说：「妇人，你为什么哭？」她说：「因为有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在哪里。」
20.en: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

20.zh: 说了这话，就转过身来，看见耶稣站在那里，却不知道是耶稣。
20.en: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

20.zh: 耶稣问她说：「妇人，为什么哭？你找谁呢？」马利亚以为是看园的，就对他说：「先生，若是你把他移了去，请告诉我，你把他放在哪里，我便去取他。」
20.en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

20.zh: 耶稣说：「马利亚。」马利亚就转过来，用希伯来话对他说：「拉波尼！」（拉波尼就是夫子的意思。）
20.en: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

20.zh: 耶稣说：「不要摸我，因我还没有升上去见我的父。你往我弟兄那里去，告诉他们说，我要升上去见我的父，也是你们的父，见我的　神，也是你们的　神。」
20.en: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

20.zh: 抹大拉的马利亚就去告诉门徒说：「我已经看见了主。」她又将主对她说的这话告诉他们。
20.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

20.zh: 那日（就是七日的第一日）晚上，门徒所在的地方，因怕犹太人，门都关了。耶稣来，站在当中，对他们说：「愿你们平安！」
20.en: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

20.zh: 说了这话，就把手和肋旁指给他们看。门徒看见主，就喜乐了。
20.en: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

20.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「愿你们平安！父怎样差遣了我，我也照样差遣你们。」
20.en: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

20.zh: 说了这话，就向他们吹一口气，说：「你们受圣灵！
20.en: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

20.zh: 你们赦免谁的罪，谁的罪就赦免了；你们留下谁的罪，谁的罪就留下了。」
20.en: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

20.zh: 那十二个门徒中，有称为低土马的多马；耶稣来的时候，他没有和他们同在。
20.en: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

20.zh: 那些门徒就对他说：「我们已经看见主了。」多马却说：「我非看见他手上的钉痕，用指头探入那钉痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我总不信。」
20.en: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

20.zh: 过了八日，门徒又在屋里，多马也和他们同在，门都关了。耶稣来，站在当中说：「愿你们平安！」
20.en: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

20.zh: 就对多马说：「伸过你的指头来，摸我的手；伸出你的手来，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，总要信！」
20.en: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

20.zh: 多马说：「我的主！我的　神！」
20.en: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

20.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你因看见了我才信；那没有看见就信的有福了。」
20.en: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

20.zh: 耶稣在门徒面前另外行了许多神迹，没有记在这书上。
20.en: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

20.zh: 但记这些事要叫你们信耶稣是基督，是　神的儿子，并且叫你们信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。
20.en: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

21.zh: 这些事以后，耶稣在提比哩亚海边又向门徒显现。他怎样显现记在下面：
21.en: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

21.zh: 有西门·彼得和称为低土马的多马，并加利利的迦拿人拿但业，还有西庇太的两个儿子，又有两个门徒，都在一处。
21.en: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

21.zh: 西门·彼得对他们说：「我打鱼去。」他们说：「我们也和你同去。」他们就出去，上了船；那一夜并没有打着什么。
21.en: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

21.zh: 天将亮的时候，耶稣站在岸上，门徒却不知道是耶稣。
21.en: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

21.zh: 耶稣就对他们说：「小子！你们有吃的没有？」他们回答说：「没有。」
21.en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

21.zh: 耶稣说：「你们把网撒在船的右边，就必得着。」他们便撒下网去，竟拉不上来了，因为鱼甚多。
21.en: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

21.zh: 耶稣所爱的那门徒对彼得说：「是主！」那时西门·彼得赤着身子，一听见是主，就束上一件外衣，跳在海里。
21.en: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

21.zh: 其余的门徒离岸不远，约有二百肘，就在小船上把那网鱼拉过来。
21.en: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

21.zh: 他们上了岸，就看见那里有炭火，上面有鱼，又有饼。
21.en: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

21.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「把刚才打的鱼拿几条来。」
21.en: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

21.zh: 西门·彼得就去，把网拉到岸上。那网满了大鱼，共一百五十三条；鱼虽这样多，网却没有破。
21.en: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

21.zh: 耶稣说：「你们来吃早饭。」门徒中没有一个敢问他：「你是谁？」因为知道是主。
21.en: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

21.zh: 耶稣就来拿饼和鱼给他们。
21.en: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

21.zh: 耶稣从死里复活以后，向门徒显现，这是第三次。
21.en: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

21.zh: 他们吃完了早饭，耶稣对西门·彼得说：「约翰的儿子西门，你爱我比这些更深吗？」彼得说：「主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。」耶稣对他说：「你喂养我的小羊。」
21.en: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

21.zh: 耶稣第二次又对他说：「约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？」彼得说：「主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。」耶稣说：「你牧养我的羊。」
21.en: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

21.zh: 第三次对他说：「约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？」彼得因为耶稣第三次对他说「你爱我吗」，就忧愁，对耶稣说：「主啊，你是无所不知的；你知道我爱你。」耶稣说：「你喂养我的羊。
21.en: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

21.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你，你年少的时候，自己束上[带子]，随意往来；但年老的时候，你要伸出手来，别人要把你束上，带你到不愿意去的地方。」
21.en: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

21.zh: （耶稣说这话是指着彼得要怎样死，荣耀　神。）说了这话，就对他说：「你跟从我吧！」
21.en: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

21.zh: 彼得转过来，看见耶稣所爱的那门徒跟着，（就是在晚饭的时候，靠着耶稣胸膛说：「主啊，卖你的是谁？」的那门徒。）
21.en: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

21.zh: 彼得看见他，就问耶稣说：「主啊，这人将来如何？」
21.en: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

21.zh: 耶稣对他说：「我若要他等到我来的时候，与你何干？你跟从我吧！」
21.en: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

21.zh: 于是这话传在弟兄中间，说那门徒不死。其实，耶稣不是说他不死，乃是说：「我若要他等到我来的时候，与你何干？」
21.en: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

21.zh: 为这些事作见证，并且记载这些事的就是这门徒；我们也知道他的见证是真的。
21.en: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

21.zh: 耶稣所行的事还有许多，若是一一地都写出来，我想，所写的书就是世界也容不下了。
21.en: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
